comment: Package kit hints for Contracts (docs/package-testing.md «Module kit file»). Contracts requires Approvals (a core service) and links to the CRM (a contract's deal, the deal picker), Masterplan (sales contracts update units; the object picker), Counterparties, Chat and Procurement. The CRM, Masterplan and Procurement are installed as linked packages; on the upgrade source (main) Masterplan is already a package, the CRM and Procurement are built in. The seed links one contract to a CRM deal through the API (the demo contracts link Masterplan units, not deals).

apiParams.id: SELECT id FROM ctr_contracts ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.dealContract: SELECT id FROM ctr_contracts WHERE deal_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.unitContract: SELECT id FROM ctr_contracts WHERE mp_node_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.approvalContract: SELECT doc_id FROM approval_processes WHERE type = 'contracts.contract' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.procContract: SELECT contract_id FROM proc_requests WHERE contract_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

pageParams.id: SELECT id FROM ctr_contracts ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

links.name: Masterplan ← a sale contract: the unit it sells and its status (deposit / sign / pay events move it)
Approvals → the route of the document type contracts.contract
Approvals → the approval of a demo contract
Masterplan → units sold by contracts follow them (catch-up summary)

openToUsersWhy.meta: module settings, the person's own rights, legal entities (no contracts)
openToUsersWhy.users: people picker (names and avatars of active users, as elsewhere in the portal)
openToUsersWhy.counters: chip counters of the contracts the person may see (numbers only; 0 for the plain user)
openToUsersWhy.link-options/deals: the CRM's deal picker with the CRM's own visibility — «all» by default: everyone signed in sees every deal in the CRM itself
